def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

# group into comps
def comps(cells,H,W):
    cs=set(cells); seen=set(); out=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        st=[s]; seen.add(s); grp=[]
        while st:
            x,y=st.pop(); grp.append((x,y)); nbs=[(a+dx,b+dy) for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if abs(dx)+abs(dy)<=1 and (a+dx,b+dy) in cs]
            st+= [n for n in nbs if n not in seen]
        out.append(grp)
    return out
cs={(r,c) for r,c,v in adds}
for comp in comps(cs,H,W):
    rs=[x for x,y in comp]; cs2=[y for x,y in comp]
    print('comp size',len(comp),'rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs2),max(cs2))

def transform(cells, orient):
    # orient: 0 plain, 1 vflip, 2 hflip, 3 rot180
    if orient==0: return sorted(cells)
    if orient==1: return [(r,-c) for r,c in cells]
    if orient==2: return [(-r,c) for r,c in cells]
    return [(-r,-c) for r,c in cells]

def find_orient(orig, trans):
    o=None
    for oi in range(4):
        tset=set(transform(sorted(orig),oi))
        if set(map(tuple,t))==set(map(tuple,trans)): o=oi;break

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps2(I,bg)
    big=[g for g in cs if len(g)>1]; singles=[sorted(g) for g in cs if len(g)==1]
    def norm(cc):
        mr=min(a for a,b in cc); mc=min(b for a,b in cc)
        return frozenset((a-mr,b-mc) for a,b in cc)
    tset=frozenset(norm(big[0])) if big else None
    # rare color: singleton colors not in tpl colors, count<=2
    rarecols=set()
    for s in singles:
        v=I[s[0]][s[1]]
        if v!=bg and v not in {I[a][b] for a,b in big[0]}: rarecols.add(v)
    rare=sorted(cnt[v] for v in rarecols)[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    def stamp(mpos):
        for off in [(-2,2),(-1,1)]:
            r,c=mpos[0]+off[0],mpos[1]+off[1]
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and I[r][c]==bg:
                out[r][c]=rare
    for s in singles:
        v=I[s[0]][s[1]]
        if v!=bg and v not in {I[a][b] for a,b in big[0]} and cnt[v]>=3:
            stamp(s)
    return out

import numpy as np, os,glob,re,json,itertools
def load(g):
    t=open(g).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

# Focus on the largest runs: gather pairs with same name from the most complete run
run='01a198de-8f57-7004-8bec-0dacc0d9a912'
d=load(run); print(sorted(d))
for i in range(1,9):
    di=np.array(d['Demo pair %d input'%i]); do=np.array(d['Demo pair %d output'%i])
    print(i,di.shape,do.shape,'crop-prefix:',np.array_equal(di[:,:do.shape[1]],do),
          'crop-suffix:',np.array_equal(di[:,di.shape[1]-do.shape[1]:],do),
          'shape-eq same:',di.shape==do.shape)

import os,glob,re,json
def load(g):
    t=open(g).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
